v6-15.candidate: Elisha’s minister rose early and went out, and behold, an army was encircling the city, with horse and chariot forces. The attendant said to him, ‘Alas, lord! What shall we do?’

v6-25.candidate: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head cost fifty shekels of silver, and a quarter of a kab of pigeons’ dung cost five shekels of silver.
